title: Forge app release
applies_to: a change to a Forge app, shipped through its deploy process (often no pull request)
summary: Ship a Forge app change from its dev box to production with the owner's go.
use_when: Any change to a Forge app that goes to production
skip_when: A change that never leaves the dev box (an experiment or a spike)

steps.title: Build and test on the app's dev box, never on prod
The app's own checks pass (its release check and tests), compared with the base so failures that were already there don't block
The app owner gives a written go naming the exact version to ship
Ship to production with the app's own release script
Check production once after the deploy: errors and the change's target numbers
